protocol.failure_event: abserr_policy > 0.5 C; missing policy error counts as failure
protocol.fold_unit: connected component of networks sharing a station_id
protocol.tie_rule: no jitter; threshold is an observed score; score <= threshold admits whole tie blocks
protocol.selection_rule: largest snapped threshold whose independence-group clustered bootstrap percentile at 1 - 0.05/n_candidates is <= 0.05
